content: @Markus de Medeiros brought up the inconsistency in using underscores in tactic names in https://github.com/leanprover-community/iris-lean/issues/426 . In particular, we currently have imodintro, but ipure_intro and iemp_intro. Should we leave this as is, or make it consistent, either by adding underscores or removing them?

/poll What naming do you prefer
imodintro, ipure_intro
imodintro, ipureintro
imod_intro, ipure_intro
It seems like the result is clear. I created https://github.com/leanprover-community/iris-lean/pull/433 to do the renaming.
